title: slack_read
description: Input schema for the fleet demo's external `slack_read` tool (ARCH §3.3 tool triple). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

oldest.description: Return only channel messages whose timestamp is strictly greater than this one. Timestamps are integer-valued strings and are compared numerically; pass back the exact `latest_ts` string a previous read returned. Omit it (or pass null) to read the whole channel from its beginning.
